📖 How to Play & Features

1. Sudoku Objective: Fill every 9x9 row, column, and 3x3 square with the numbers 1 through 9 without repeating any digits.

2. Backtracking Visualizer: Click Watch Solve to see how the computer systematically tests numbers. When a path runs into a contradiction, it steps backward (backtracks) and tries the next candidate, just like your Python code!

3. Vercel Hosting: Because this is standard HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no desktop windowing dependencies, you can host it on Vercel simply by pushing index.html to your GitHub repository.
